title: How does Pinnacle Blooms Network handle challenging behaviors during therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Handling Challenging Behaviors - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network handles challenging behaviors during therapy sessions, providing a secure environment for your child's comfort and optimal progress.
html: Managing challenging behaviors is part of our expertise at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Our therapists are trained for these moments. We create an environment that's consistent and predictable to add a sense of comfort and security for your child. We emphasize on clear communication, and often include them in small decisions related to activities, giving them a sense of control. We make sure our expectations are clear, achievable and communicated in a friendly manner. And above all, we use positive reinforcement to applaud and encourage good behavior, helping them understand and manage their emotions better.
